entities.summary: Luis Borroto Jiménez is a Cuban baseball player. He was born in Sagua la Grande, Villa Clara Province, Cuba. A starting pitcher with Villa Clara of the Cuban National Series, Borroto competed internationally with the Cuba national baseball team at the 2004 Summer Olympics and the 2006 World Baseball Classic.
